title: From the applicant to the recruiter — a visual story test

scenes.narration: A candidate finds an open position and prepares an application before contacting the company.
The candidate picks up a phone and sends the application to the company's recruiting team.
scenes.action: An application is sent from the candidate's phone.

scenes.narration: The message travels from the candidate's phone to the recruiter at the company office.
scenes.action: The message moves across two connected endpoints.

scenes.narration: The recruiter reviews the application and contacts the candidate to schedule an interview.
scenes.action: The recruiter invites the candidate to an interview.
